claims.originating_goal: Provide a bounded generic account lifecycle that proves create-account, verified recovery attributes, manual/automated login, post-login account management, and recovery-driven password reset without claiming production identity or real message delivery.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact account lifecycle validation passes, PR merges, and public publication of login/create/recovery pages is observed; otherwise remain fail-closed with this claim.
expected_evidence: manual page visibly renders LOGIN before submission
created account requires at least one verified Email/Text recovery attribute
accepted created account yields SUCCESS through the normal form submit handler
Successful Login replaces the login card with account attributes
Email and Text number show verified values with change actions
Email/Text replacement requires verification of the proposed new value
Password change routes through the same Forgot Password recovery algorithm
wrong credentials yield FAILED through the normal form submit handler
real email/SMS delivery is not claimed until a transport is attached
collision_boundaries: test-only surface; no production identity/session authority
no SKAP credential authority or credential custody
no real secret values in repository state
do not modify existing production login/authentication surfaces
no provider credential or GitHub-token runtime authority
claims.next_task_after_release: Use the published lifecycle for physical create/login/account-management/reset verification, then attach a real email or SMS transport without changing the verified recovery state machine.
